name: Nested menus
description: AmberX's application menu and navigation generated from its registry (nested-menu@1, the same generator the Dev Console and Molly use): approvals, every plugin's pages, dialogs and settings, as categories and sub menus with at most 12 rows per level, Favourites and Recent on top and Jump to…. Overrides the shared app-menu and nav-menu assets (on by default). Settings → Plugins → Menus.

items.title: Open a menu entry by id
Change one menu setting
items.description: Fields: maxPerLevel (4-30), recentsMax (0-24), showFavorites, showRecents, groupByPlugin, style (list|rail|pills), hidden (ids), favorites (ids).

commands.noReads: no data folder: favourites, recents and the settings are per-device settings (axf.menus.*)
